content:
Nia (CS): Heads-up: BeaconHealth onboarding showed worse tail latency after yesterday's marketing surge. Median up ~22%, p95 spikes on short templated prompts. They're flagged as moderate renewal risk. Proposing a low-risk perf play: small canary to compact-int8, split routing short vs long, and bump prefix cache TTL. Thoughts? :triage_flag:

Tom (SRE): +1. Proposed safe rollout: 1) 5% canary -> redwood-compact-small-int8 2) Route requests with tokens<=192 to compact; longer stay on standard 3) Increase prefix cache TTL for repeated templates to 800s. Will add auto-fallback.

Rina (Solutions): On quality: our internal eval on Beacon prompts shows compact-small-int8 has ~0.4-1.1% drop on intent/QA metrics depending on prompt. Recommend staged scorer checks and a conservative decoding preset if customer cares about exactness.

Owen (AM): BeaconHealth will want cost/latency estimates for renewal touch. Can we quantify expected per-token compute savings and likely impact on SLA? If compact path is ~20% cheaper with latency win that's good for retention.

Tom (SRE): Draft routes policy for staging:

```yaml
routes:
  - id: beacon-short-route
    match: request.tokens <= 192
    rollout:
      - model: redwood-compact-small-int8
        percent: 5
      - model: redwood-standard-v2
        percent: 95
    fallback: redwood-standard-v2
    cache: { prefix_ttl: 800s }
```

Tom (SRE): Canary guardrails: auto-rollback if (a) eval intent-score drops >1.5%, (b) p95 latency > SLA for 3 consecutive 5m windows, or (c) error-rate >1%.

Nia (CS): I'll schedule a 20m sync with BeaconHealth Wed 9am PT. Action items: Tom -> spin canary & run evals by Tue EOD; Rina -> brief quality deltas and knob recommendations; Owen -> prepare cost/latency slide. ci-bot, kick the canary when ready. :calendar:

ci-bot: Canary pipeline started (#canary-beacon-586412)  running compact-small-int8 evaluation. Link: https://ci.internal/canaries/586412

Tom (SRE): Canary 30m snapshot: median latency -28% on short path, p95 -12%, eval intent-score -0.6%, errors stable. Will expand to 10% if no regressions in next 90m.

Rina (Solutions): I'll include fallback knobs: temp=0.6, top_k=60, and enable conservative decoding for high-risk templates. That recovers ~0.3-0.5% on intent in our sims.

Nia (CS): Perfect. We'll present Wed and keep fallback active for quick revert. I'll post customer feedback and next steps after the call. :white_check_mark:
